verses.en: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.pt: Julga-me, ó Senhor, pois tenho andado na minha integridade; no Senhor tenho confiado sem vacilar.
verses.en_web: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> O Lord, be my judge, for my behaviour has been upright: I have put my faith in the Lord, I am not in danger of slipping.

verses.en: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.pt: Examina-me, Senhor, e prova-me; esquadrinha o meu coração e a minha mente.
verses.en_web: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
verses.en_bbe: Put me in the scales, O Lord, so that I may be tested; let the fire make clean my thoughts and my heart.

verses.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.pt: Pois a tua benignidade está diante dos meus olhos, e tenho andado na tua verdade.
verses.en_web: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
verses.en_bbe: For your mercy is before my eyes; and I have gone in the way of your good faith.

verses.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.pt: Não me tenho assentado com homens falsos, nem associo com dissimuladores.
verses.en_web: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
verses.en_bbe: I have not taken my seat with foolish persons, and I do not go with false men.

verses.en: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.pt: Odeio o ajuntamento de malfeitores; não me sentarei com os ímpios.
verses.en_web: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: I have been a hater of the band of wrongdoers, and I will not be seated among sinners.

verses.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
verses.pt: Lavo as minhas mãos na inocência; e assim, ó Senhor, me acerco do teu altar,
verses.en_web: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: I will make my hands clean from sin; so will I go round your altar, O Lord;

verses.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.pt: para fazer ouvir a voz de louvor, e contar todas as tuas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
verses.en_bbe: That I may give out the voice of praise, and make public all the wonders which you have done.

verses.en: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, eu amo o recinto da tua casa e o lugar onde permanece a tua glória.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, your house has been dear to me, and the resting-place of your glory.

verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.pt: Não colhas a minha alma com a dos pecadores, nem a minha vida a dos homens sanguinolentos,
verses.en_web: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
verses.en_bbe: Let not my soul be numbered among sinners, or my life among men of blood;

verses.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.pt: em cujas mãos há malefício, e cuja destra está cheia de subornos.
verses.en_web: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.en_bbe: In whose hands are evil designs, and whose right hands take money for judging falsely.

verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, porém, ando na minha integridade; resgata-me e tem compaixão de mim.
verses.en_web: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
verses.en_bbe: But as for me, I will go on in my upright ways: be my saviour, and have mercy on me.

verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.pt: O meu pé está firme em terreno plano; nas congregações bendirei ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I have a safe resting-place for my feet; I will give praise to the Lord in the meetings of the people.
